entries.stable_expression: When genre inertia is not amplified by high-load situations, genre cues can be used to observe expressions that are more stable and have more leeway.
entries.average_expression: In most ordinary situations, people may fall back on familiar strategies for dealing with order, relationships, security, results, or tranquility.
entries.strained_expression: When task load, interaction tension, or insufficient recovery space are superimposed, the same set of strategies may be used harder and narrower; this is just a review reminder.
entries.recovery_action: First name the most obvious observable clue at the moment, and then choose a low-risk small action for verification; this is not a treatment suggestion, nor is it used to judge whether the state is good or bad.
entries.disclaimer: This is a spectrum of self-calibration and interpretation that only describes changes in expression in situations, not medical, mental health, or graded conclusions.
